title: Patient Payment Plans Schedule of Late-Posting Shares for Enrolled Encounter Charges
content:
A charge posted for an encounter already enrolled on a proposed Patient Payment Plans plan, and posted late relative to its date of service, keeps a late-posting share when it is enrolled on the plan.

| Posting date, in calendar days after the date of service | Late-posting share |
|---|---|
| 60 days or more | 0.90 |
| 30 days or more, fewer than 60 | 0.95 |
| Fewer than 30 days | 1 |

**Schedule rule.** The late-posting share is 0.90 when the charge's posting date is at least 60 calendar days after its date of service, 0.95 when it is at least 30 but fewer than 60 days after, and 1 when it is posted fewer than 30 days after the date of service. The share multiplies the charge's remaining balance, without intermediate rounding.

**Records read.** The date of service and the posting date carried on the charge.

**Boundary days (hypothetical dates, date of service 1 March).**

| Posting date | Days after the date of service | Share |
|---|---|---|
| 30 April | 60 | 0.90 |
| 29 April | 59 | 0.95 |
| 31 March | 30 | 0.95 |
| 30 March | 29 | 1 |

**Figure (hypothetical).** A charge with a remaining balance of 250.00 posted 45 days after its date of service: 250.00 multiplied by 0.95 is 237.50.
